name: multi-agent-folder-cleanup
description: Audit, plan, and safely reorganize shared project folders so AI agents can find current authority without duplicate or ambiguous trees.

interface.shortDescription: Safely audit and reorganize shared agent workspaces
interface.longDescription: Find conflicting authority, stale indexes, duplicate documents, generated noise, and unsafe move conditions in shared project folders. Plan or execute verified reorganizations only within an explicitly approved scope.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $multi-agent-folder-cleanup to audit this shared project folder and explain what is authoritative, stale, or ambiguous.
